WITH org00 AS (SELECT * FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, f_today())) SELECT emp03_trans_id AS trans_id, emp01_person_id AS person_id, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, org00_org_id AS org_code_id, org00_kor_nm AS org_kor_nm, f_get_empTrans(emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_nm FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON org00_org_id = emp03_org_code_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(emp01_kor_nm, org00_kor_nm, emp01_emp_no)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= #{transDate} )
AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') /** 겸직과 퇴직은 제외 */
AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('900') /** 퇴직만 제외 */
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp03_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > #{transDate} OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{transDate} ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(org00_sort_order, org00_org_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd) , emp01_emp_no
